next.reason: 1985: a figurative constant as literal-1 or literal-2 'refers to an implicit one character data item whose usage is DISPLAY'. §2023:14.9.43.4 GR2: 'it refers to an implicit one character data item whose usage shall be the same as the usage of identifier-3, either display or national'; 1985 SR2 forces identifier-3 to DISPLAY, so every 1985 program gets the same one-character DISPLAY item. §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 restates the one-character length.
